description: Which Japanese laws are due for their statutory review, and when?. 2,816 review clauses (見直し規定) in 888 Japanese laws, each with its base event and date, the number of years, and the computed due date, with an e-Gov link to the law. Ask what is due in a window, a month-by-month summary with the reviews already overdue, or every review clause of one law. Facts from statute text only; no personal data. Routes: /due (from, to, limit); /law (q, law_id); /answer (months). Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /due, /law, /answer. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: jp-law-reviews
